title: Volume Rate for Added Names
content:
**Pricing schedule note — SSL/TLS Certificates, names added to a multi-domain certificate**

The yearly price of a name added to an SSL/TLS Certificates subscription carries a volume rate that follows two facts the subscription shows on the day the name is added: how many extra names the subscription already records, and how many calendar days remain from today to the subscription end date.

## The rate

1. Where the subscription already records **at least 50** extra names and **more than 365** days remain to the subscription end date, the added name's yearly price is multiplied by **40 percent**.
2. Where the subscription records **at least 10 but fewer than 50** extra names and **more than 365** days remain, the added name's yearly price is multiplied by **60 percent**.
3. In every other case the added name's yearly price is not multiplied by any volume rate.

The count is the number of extra names recorded on the subscription before the name being added; the included names of the product are not part of it. The days remaining are counted in calendar days from today to the subscription end date.

## Rate by count and remaining term

| Extra names already recorded | More than 365 days remain | 365 days or fewer remain |
|---|---|---|
| 9 or fewer | no volume rate | no volume rate |
| 10 to 49 | 60 percent | no volume rate |
| 50 or more | 40 percent | no volume rate |

## Points either side of each threshold

- 9 extra names recorded, 700 days remaining: no volume rate. 10 extra names recorded, 700 days remaining: 60 percent.
- 49 extra names recorded, 700 days remaining: 60 percent. 50 extra names recorded, 700 days remaining: 40 percent.
- 63 extra names recorded, 366 days remaining: 40 percent. The same subscription with exactly 365 days remaining: no volume rate.

## Hypothetical illustration

A hypothetical Harborline DV Multi-Domain subscription records 63 extra names and 512 days remain to its end date. Its price per added name per year is 14.99. The count is at least 50 and more than 365 days remain, so the added name's yearly price is 40 percent of 14.99, that is 5.996. Had the same subscription recorded 23 extra names, the yearly price would have been 60 percent of 14.99, that is 8.994; with 512 days remaining and only 7 extra names recorded, it stays at 14.99.
